# Debrief: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus

These clips show how OpenTelemetry and Prometheus fit together: Prometheus ingests OTLP and native histograms, the Collector scrapes and transforms Prometheus metrics, and Jaeger derives span metrics into Prometheus. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Prometheus has added features to its OTLP receive endpoint. Native histograms are stable, and since 3.9 you must configure ingestion at the scrape level. Exporters and Kubernetes still need to expose them. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
2. One team's Collector pipeline used the Prometheus receiver to scrape metrics endpoints, then transformed resource attributes, exported OTLP to a backend, and kept long-term copies in S3-compatible storage. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s))
3. Jaeger can derive latency, error rate and request rate from spans and send them to Prometheus via remote write, scraping or OTLP. Prometheus is its only supported metrics backend, and the feature is off by default. ([Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s))

## Action items

- [ ] Review Prometheus's OTLP receive endpoint additions and check whether native histograms fit your setup, including the scrape-level configuration required since 3.9. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
- [ ] Prototype a Collector pipeline with the Prometheus receiver, a resource-attribute processor and an OTLP exporter, starting from the contrib image to avoid missing components. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 12:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=720s))
- [ ] Check dashboards for metric naming differences before migrating: underscores versus periods in OTLP-based names, as the team in one talk found when updating their Grafana queries. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s); [OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 18:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=1128s))

2. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s) (1:22), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Concrete Collector pipeline scraping Prometheus endpoints and exporting OTLP.
3. [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s) (3:44), Pavol Loffay: Shows span-derived metrics flowing into Prometheus.
4. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s) (1:38), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Practical notes on naming changes and dashboard migration.
